response: ["Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.", "Surgical margins for melanoma excision should be based on tumor thickness.", "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma tumor.", "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible.", "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.", "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as facial lesions (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions.", "The consensus rate for the recommendation that the whole lesion be excised with a narrow margin is 100 % (21/21)."]
